scope: CPU mathematical port for separately authorized adapted zero-shot Sim2Sim; no actor or checkpoint loading, no policy commands, no original simulator execution
original_license: Isaac Lab BSD-3-Clause notice retained in full in port; installed Isaac Sim utility functions are used only as local in-memory test oracles, not redistributed

precision.target: NumPy float64 for double MuJoCo state and controller; raw19 and frozen RMS output float32
precision.claim: equation/semantic port, not bitwise PhysX equivalence
precision.finite_difference_limitation: float32 source world-pose differencing has conversion error amplified by120; target double differs numerically

fields.field: world TCP position minus noisy reset hole top
raw world TCP quaternion wxyz; no sign canonicalization
world TCP physics-step position finite difference
world angular finite difference: axis_angle(sign(dq.w)*dq)/dt, dq=qnow*conj(qprevious)
internal EMA action history, not raw policy output

observation.reset_reference: b=root_reset+R(root_quat_reset)*[0,0,.025]+episode_noise; both observation and action references cached
observation.noise_contract: caller explicitly supplies once-per-episode noise; source sigma=.001m eachworld axis; None is specified zero-noise diagnostic, not source RNG emulation
observation.reset_cache: xyz=(p-b)/.05 without clipping; xy rotation0; yaw after left unrot(-pi), source modulo2pi, >pi/2 subtract2pi, <-pi add2pi, then (yaw+pi)/(3pi/2)*2-1
observation.fd_cache: one update per new simulation physics timestamp; repeated unchanged pose timestamp reusesFD, skipped or backwards dt rejected
observation.half_turn_branch: exact dq.w=0 gives sign(0)=0 then zero angularFD as source; not repaired
observation.privileged_state_assumption: simulator ground-truth TCP pose, hole reset pose and reference noise state are used; no perception/sensor observability claim
observation.normalization: provided immutable frozenmean/variance metadata; castfloat32, (obs-mean)/sqrt(var+1e-5), clip[-5,5], no statistic updates
observation.lstm: not loaded/executed; existing frozen two-layer1024 h/c reset contract remains separate from EMA reset; eventual policyintegration must reset both

action.rotation: rotvec=.097*cache_rot; <=1e-6 identity; qpre=dq_world*qcurrent; sourceextrinsicXYZ; overwrite roll3.14159,pitch0, retain modulo2pi yaw; convertwxyz
action.gripper: zero positiontarget; independentphysicalfingerPD adaptation in environment, not armcontroller; armfunctiondoesnotaddfingerforce

controller.error: target-current position; targetsign by dot(target,current)>=0 then axis_angle(target*inverse(current)) worldorientation
controller.wrench: Kp*poseerror-Kd*[linearFD,angularFD]; desiredtaskvelocityzero; this is commanded PD wrench, not contact measurement
controller.jacobian: mean of left/right finger BODY-origin worldgeometric6x7, stackjacpabovejacr; separateTCPpose; explicitly not replacing by TCPsiteJ
controller.mass_matrix: full MuJoCo denseM principal7armDOFblock, namedjointaddressmapping; independent6DOFpeg not concatenatedintoarmblock
controller.raw_joint_velocity: seven mapped qvel components, not joint or taskFD
controller.formula: tau_task=J.T@F; Lambda=inv(J@inv(M)@J.T); J_hash=Lambda@J@inv(M); u=M@(10*wrap(qdefault-q)-6.3246*qdot); tau_null=(I-J.T@J_hash)@u; requested=tau_task+tau_null; software=clip(requested,-100,100)
controller.invalid_state: explicit ValueError before command for nonfinite, nonunitquat, nonsymmetric/nonpositiveM, rankdeficientJ, unresolvedinversecondition>=1/float64eps; no zerosubstitution or retry
